name: IceBreaker
summary: Browse and play your RomM game library with a controller
description: IceBreaker connects to your RomM server and turns your game collection into a controller-first launcher: it downloads games, starts the right emulator and keeps your saves in sync with RomM. Game launcher for RomM, a port of Argosy for desktop: based on Argosy by the RomM team. IceBreaker is an independent port and is not affiliated with or endorsed by rommapp.
notes: Based on Argosy by the RomM team; an independent port, not affiliated with rommapp.
Needs a RomM server. Emulators run from your system or from Flathub; IceBreaker can install the ones you need.
Formerly Argosy Desktop: testers of io.github.stealthx3.ArgosyDesktop are moved to IceBreaker by flatpak update.
